title: Instrument Efficiency Comparison
description: Quantifies and compares the net efficiency of ETF, CFD, futures and options on the same underlying asset. Real costs applied — spreads, commissions, swap rates, theta decay, rollover costs and broker fees normalised to a common basis.
feature1: Net return vs gross return across all instrument types
feature2: Real broker fee schedule applied per instrument
feature3: Cost drag breakdown: spread, commission, carry, decay
feature4: Delta-adjusted notional equivalence for fair comparison
